sections.title: Intelligent Workflow Automation
sections.subtitle: Connect people, applications and AI in one workflow

sections.heading: Keep work moving across systems
sections.body:
Intelligent Workflow Automation brings reusable workflow and integration patterns into business processes. It connects application tasks with AI-supported decisions so teams can manage work across systems.

Use it to structure repeatable processes, coordinate AI tasks and support underwriting decisions. Start with a defined workflow, then adapt the accelerator to its data, rules and review needs.

sections.heading: Automation from task to decision
sections.description: Four capabilities for connected enterprise workflows.

cards.title: Workflow automation
cards.description: Move repeatable tasks through defined steps, with clear hand-offs and exception handling to keep work moving.

cards.title: AI orchestration
cards.description: Coordinate AI tasks within a workflow, passing the right context between steps and keeping human review where it is needed.

cards.title: Application integration
cards.description: Connect applications so information can flow between systems without repeated manual entry.

cards.title: Underwriting optimisation
cards.description: Bring data checks and decision support into underwriting workflows to help teams assess cases consistently.

sections.heading: Build around the workflow that matters

items.description: Map the process, its owners and its exceptions. Choose a repeatable workflow with a clear business outcome.
Connect the required applications and data. Define access, decision rules and where human approval is needed.
Adapt the workflow and AI tasks to the process. Test normal paths, incomplete inputs and exceptions before release.
Introduce the workflow into daily operations. Review hand-offs and outcomes, then refine the steps as needs change.
